Great early season form came from vaulter Mike Edwards. At a College All-Comers meeting he opened at 5.35 and soared cleared at his first attempt.

Paul Edwards broke Mike Edwards record of consecutive league wins by asserting his superiority in all of the shot competitions. But the revelation was Leith Marar who was in his first full year competing in our 'A' squad.
